title: Fix scalar tensor indexing under export
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #184625

Use symbolic scalar extraction for 0-d integral tensor indices so export can keep scalar tensor indexing on the select path, and preserve scalar item memoization for plain FakeTensorMode inputs.

Fixes #182345
